VI.description: Read {LV.Application} Project\3AActive Project and report both WHETHER a project is active and WHICH ONE.\0A\0AWHY THE PATH MATTERS. Almost everything that edits a class needs the project ACTIVE rather than merely open\2C and error 1055 is what a caller gets when none is. But `a project is active` is not the question a caller is really asking - it wants ITS project active. Measured 2026-09-18\3A after lvai_create_class had opened and closed project A\2C an open of A answered No Error while a DIFFERENT project was still the active one\2C so the next call answered Error 1055 with nothing anywhere saying which project LabVIEW was actually looking at. Two arms of an A/B were spent on that before it was spotted.\0A\0AREAD ONLY. The reference is closed again and nothing is written.

Indicator.description: Standard error status of the read.
Error code of the read\3B 1055 means no project is active.
Absolute path of the project that is ACTIVE\2C empty when none is. This is what tells a caller whether the active project is the one it asked for.
